_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars/forks/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.name: Connect
projects.description: Next-Gen real-time social messaging & media platform. WebRTC audio/video calling, Socket.IO, Meta-style Accounts Center, AI voice-to-text, and native Android APK via Capacitor.

projects.name: Shopy-Atelier
projects.description: Ultra-luxury fashion flagship e-commerce platform. Built with Next.js 14 App Router, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis atomic mutex locks, and bidirectional Google Sheets sync.

projects.name: HammadOS
projects.description: Custom x86 Operating System kernel and memory management architecture in C and Assembly, with safety guidelines and virtualization in QEMU.

projects.name: Chat-Animations-Engine
projects.description: High-framerate physics-based message choreography and fluid micro-interactions for modern real-time communication platforms.
